name: Scratch
description: Self-hosted offline build of the official MIT Scratch 3.0 editor — no accounts, no online community features, just the block-based programming editor served as static files via nginx.

notes.text: The default 4 CPU / 6 GB RAM is only needed for the initial build; the container idles much lower afterwards and can be shrunk.
This is the offline Scratch-GUI editor only. There are no user accounts, no cloud save, and no access to the online Scratch community — projects are saved/loaded as local .sb3 files from the browser.
